subject: Mutual action plan & phased onboarding — NovaGrid integration
messages:
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia@novagrid.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procure.admin@novagrid.com, ethan.liu@novagrid.com
Date: Tue, 18 Nov 2025 09:32:00 -0800
Subject: NovaGrid onboarding - draft MAP and timing

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency and the routing fallback concept. We need to lock an operational plan so that our procurement and engineering teams can commit to dates.

Attached is a first-pass MAP (excel) from our side with milestones we care about: pilot API calls, security review completion, data ingestion cutover, and go-live. Two asks:
- Can Redwood confirm phase owners and realistic target dates for each milestone?
- We have a hard SLA requirement for fallbacks during peak windows — can you propose a fallback SLA and an on-call escalation owner?

High-level constraints: procurement needs signed T&Cs by 12/15 to hit the planned Jan pilot; infra team needs the private deployment checklist by 12/1 to schedule resources.

Regards,
Sofia Martinez
Director, Platform Partnerships
NovaGrid

[Attachment: 2025-11-18_NovaGrid_MAP_v1.xlsx (Excel, 42KB)]

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia@novagrid.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, procure.admin@novagrid.com
Date: Wed, 19 Nov 2025 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NovaGrid onboarding - draft MAP and timing

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear deck and dates. I reviewed the MAP and proposed a phased plan below (I attached an updated MAP with owners/dates). Short summary first, then the phase table.

Summary / proposed cadence:
- Phase A (Discovery & Security): finalize SOC2 artifact handoff, threat model review, and network diagram — target 2025-12-05. Owners: Marissa (CS), Ben (sec liaison).
- Phase B (Pilot & Integration): test harness + 10k sample calls, validate KV cache behavior — target 2026-01-15. Owner: Karthik (integration lead) with Prio from Ben for perf tuning.
- Phase C (Staged Rollout): production pilot, canary traffic, rollback policy — target 2026-02-01. Owners: NovaGrid infra + Redwood ops (Marissa).

Fallback SLA proposal (short):
- Primary: 99.5% availability for the primary model endpoint during core hours (08:00-20:00 PT).
- Fallback: automated routing to compatible quantized variant with degraded latency profile; fallback activation within 45s of detection.
- Escalation owner: ben.carter@redwood.ai (primary), priyom.das@redwood.ai (secondary)

Immediate asks for your team:
1) Confirm procurement milestone (12/15 signature).
2) Confirm NovaGrid infra can accept test dataset by 2025-12-01.
3) Accept proposed fallback SLA or provide adjustments.

I'll attach the updated MAP (v1.1) with specific milestones, acceptance criteria, and a short RACI. If this looks good we'll schedule a 30-min alignment call next week to lock owners and the kickoff date (I propose 2025-11-30 for a 30-min kickoff).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

[Attachment: 2025-11-19_NovaGrid_MAP_v1.1.xlsx (Excel, 58KB)]

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia@novagrid.com>, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NovaGrid onboarding - draft MAP and timing

Sofia — thanks for the MAP and Karthik for the clear phases. A couple of operational notes from CS & Ops that I want captured in the plan before we call it final:

1) Acceptance criteria for Phase B (Pilot):
   - 95th p95 latency under 450ms for 50-concurrent sessions on the pilot dataset.
   - Successful end-to-end logs ingestion for 7 consecutive days with no dropped events.

2) SLA fallback detail: my recommendation is to add an automatic throttling policy during fallback to protect upstream systems (rate window + token bucket). Ben, can you take point to draft the fallback runbook?

3) Escalation & business continuity: if fallback persists > 2 hours during business hours, NovaGrid ops and Redwood leadership will run a joint incident bridge. I'll be the CS contact for scheduling the bridge.

If you agree I'll add these as redline items in the MAP and share v1.2. We can lock dates on our Nov 30 kickoff.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Lead — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

[Attachment: SLA-fallback-draft.pdf (PDF, 12KB)]

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia@novagrid.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 22 Nov 2025 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NovaGrid onboarding - draft MAP and timing (Agreed path & kickoff)

Appended final: thanks all — this thread captured everything we discussed during the working calls. Quick confirmation of next steps so procurement and engineering can calendar: 

- KICKOFF: 2025-11-30 at 10:00 PT (30 mins) — Zoom link will be shared by CS.
- MAP v1.2: I'll upload the redlined MAP with Phase A/B/C owners and acceptance criteria by EOD Monday 11/24.
- Procurement: NovaGrid to confirm final signature timeline; Redwood will share the MSA & exhibit (DocuSign) a week prior to 12/15.
- Test data: NovaGrid to deliver the initial sample set by 2025-12-01.
- Fallback runbook: Ben will produce runbook v0.1 and share with you by 2025-11-27.

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/NG-2025-1427) | MAP folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExample/novagrid-onboarding) | DocuSign MSA (https://www.docusign.com/NG-MSA-1427)

If NovaGrid confirms the procurement target and test data window we will lock the pilot start date in mid-Jan as proposed. Looking forward to kickoff.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
